truncated.description: older entries have been evicted by the per-instance limit (LONG-03)

active.description: elements with a token, several through parallel branches and event-based gateways

elements.description: passes of elements and sequence flows in the run (DBG-06, DBG-07)

reconstructed.description:
set by the history: the state was reconstructed from a snapshot and activity entries;
FirstSeq is the earliest step that can still be reconstructed (DBG-14)

seq.description: last activity entry the state includes

variables.description: instance variables; local variables are at their element in Active

faulty_since.description: set when automatic restarts exceeded the restart policy; no automatic restarts until reset (INC-04)

managed_by.description: the instance that manages the deployment through a module (NS-08)

model_deleted.description: the referenced model has been deleted; the deployment keeps its copy of the BPMN (MOD-08)

retention_days.description: retention of history in days, 0 uses the namespace default; capped by the limits (HIST-04)

incident_handling.description: nil uses the default of the namespace

parameters.description: overrides of inputs, event variables and timers per BPMN element id

selections.description: device selection per BPMN element id (DEP-05)
device selection per BPMN element id (DEP-05)

message_name.description: the message name the correlation uses, stable across updates

path.description: empty: the path follows from function and aspects

qos.description: 1: the message is acknowledged only after the correlation; 0: at most once (EVT-05)

script.description: condition: true, "true" or a number >= 1 triggers the event

service.description: the service to unmarshal with; artificial for imports

topic.description: the Kafka topic with the data

next.description: more evaluations follow; pass it as After for the next page

current.description: evaluation of the current value of the source, on request (DBG-18)

last_activity_at.description: last time an element was entered or left (LONG-13)

parent_id.description: a maintenance procedure refers to the instance it belongs to (SMS-13)

restart_at.description: an automatic restart after an incident is due at this time (INC-02)

status.description: summary for users, derived on read (SMS-11)

deployment_id.description: the value is deleted with this deployment or instance (IO-03)

initial_rights.description: rights every new resource gets besides the owner's administrate

register.description:
register resources in permissions-v2 although the level is not shareable, so that it can
become shareable later without backfill; nil means true. Shareable levels are always registered.

shareable.description: rights of others from permissions-v2 count; otherwise only the owner and admins have access

topic_default_permissions.description: DefaultPermissions of the permissions-v2 topic; they apply to every resource of the topic

variables.description: values of the procedure's parameters; they extend the start variables of the instance

all.description: correlate with all waiting instances and message start events instead of exactly one

instance_id.description: optional target instance; with a message start event the instance is started under this id

message_id.description: idempotency key; a message with a known id is not correlated twice with the same target (EVT-05)

owner.description: restricts correlation to resources of this owner; required for admins acting for a tenant

events.description: sources of a device or import event; empty for messages sent through the API

issues.description: validation hints of the latest version; a model with issues can be saved but not deployed (MOD-04)

owner.description: only admins may create a resource for another owner (SEC-11)

created_by.description: the instance whose task created the module, a maintenance procedure or the instance itself

error.description: finding of the last health check; shown in the status of the instance (SMS-11)

resource.description: a deployment, instance or watch of the engine (NS-08)

forbid_cycles.description:
reject sequence flow cycles at deploy, so that every run ends; for namespaces whose task
types create modules, which are removed with every new run (SMS-03)

http.description: targets of the task type http, separately for cloud and gateway (NS-04)

incident_handling.description: default for deployments without own setting

json_string_parameters.description:
non-string values of string form fields are stored as JSON strings, as Camunda did; models
of smart services parse them, e.g. a list of selected devices (SMS-08)

message_starts_are_procedures.description:
message start events with a name are maintenance procedures of an instance and start only
through it, not by correlation (SMS-13)

referenced_namespaces.description: namespaces whose resources this namespace may create through task types (NS-08)

user_deletion.description: what happens to resources of others that depend on a deleted user (SEC-13): reject or cascade

has_no_valid_option.description: a required IoT parameter without any option the user may choose

options.description: nil allows free input; IoT parameters always have a list

type.description: https://schema.org/Text, Integer, Float, Boolean or the form field type

needs_same_entity_id_in_parameter.description: the option fits only to the entity selected in that parameter

value.description: for IoT parameters the JSON of the selection, the value modules read

deployment_version.description: 0 selects the current version of the deployment

issues.description: validation findings; with issues the deployment would be rejected (BPMN-18)

lane.description: elements of a lane share their devices; the options fulfill the criteria of all of them

deployment_version.description: 0 selects the current version of the deployment

max_restarts.description: automatic restarts per deployment within Window; above, the deployment is marked faulty

cron.description: cron with 5 or 6 fields (optional seconds first) or a descriptor such as @daily

path.description: the value of the function in the service and the values of its configurables

prefer_event.description: read the last event value instead of sending a command, for services with event and request (TASK-08)

subtasks.description: device commands: one per device, with groups several (TASK-04)

blocked.description: true if the deletion would be rejected because a namespace rejects foreign dependents

owned.description: counts of own resources per namespace and kind, e.g. "processes_models"

gateway_id.description: the event-based gateway the wait belongs to; the first event cancels the others

Bearer.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
Bearer.name: Authorization
